# Footnote Definitions

The text calls the first note[^called] and the second in another
case[^Upper].

[^called]: A note that the text calls.

[^upper]: A note that the text calls in another case.

[^unused]: A note that nothing calls.

[^long]: A note over two lines,
    whose second line belongs to it.

[^url]: /also-a-link-definition

[^twice]: The first of two notes with one label.

[^twice]: The second of them.

- [^listed]: A note in a list, which gomdlint cannot be sure of.
